name: regression-proof-clarity
goal: Show historical failure and passing fix clearly without claiming full verification

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The paired card presents an intentional historical failure as an unqualified failing test. Show that it failed before repair and passed at the linked fix; red-only revisions must remain unresolved.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: runtime-evidence-ui: regression history checks links, raw outputs and no future fix, but lacks an assertion distinguishing historical failure from a passing fixed result. Strengthen its existing shared review flow at all declared viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed 0273faf6 before product repair. The unchanged runtime-evidence-ui review fails because Regression fixed is absent. Harness sealed record f7c6a17a55d709e96a0c859ad75108ce13b4602cd66daf40452f6df344aea2ce with 1255 frozen inputs.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Updated the shared proof card: historical failure, passing fix and per-revision resolution. Preserved outputs, links and verification boundaries. The unchanged browser regression passes all three viewports in the working tree.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Harness sealed 0273faf6 failed -> 471d75c9 passed. Identical command, environment profile and 1255 frozen inputs. The existing browser regression passes at all three declared viewports.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: 24 relevant unit checks and 8 browser acceptance checks pass; types, lint, formatting, audit, registry and explanations pass. Manually verified actual historical logs and no future fix on red revision; fresh screenshots inspected. Full repository/Electron acceptance remains paused and unchanged simulator-test lint debt remains outside this scope.
